digest.component_or_area: LLM provider seam and support tier policy documentation
propositions: An ADR recording the provider seam design (pydantic-ai's provider_factory hook) and two-tier support policy (first-class Anthropic+Bedrock vs best-effort everything else) must be written with all rejected alternatives and their evidence documented.

Documentation in docs/llm-framework.md must be brought in line with implemented code: provider resolution via rebar registry, Bedrock support, tier model with guarantees per tier, and corrected numeric defaults (max_tokens=16000 not 8000, max_iterations=250 not 50).
Every runnable command in docs/llm-framework.md's provider section must be executed and verified to produce documented results, with evidence recorded on the ticket.
The generated docs/env-vars.md must produce zero diff after regeneration, proving the env-var registry is current and complete.
